description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the utility functions in 'db_utils.php' within the SuiteCRM project. It tests various database conversion functions, HTML encoding/decoding, and database name validation.

classes.name: db_utilsTest
classes.description: Test suite for database utility functions in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: db_convertProvider
methods.description: Data provider supplying test cases for db_convert function.

methods.description: Tests the db_concat function for correct SQL string formation.

methods.name: testfrom_db_convert
methods.description: Verifies from_db_convert correctly converts database strings to formatted dates/times.
